# Setup

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
  source("./Parameters.R")
  library(mgcv)
  library(broom)

  # configurable parameters
  MAX_LAG <- 14 # maximum number of days to look back for exposures (one week)
  DELTA_T <-  4 # distance between knots for temperature exposure (above 10°C): step size 4°C
  print(sprintf("LAGS = 0:%s [days], DELTA_T = %.1f [°C]", MAX_LAG, DELTA_T))

  days_analyze <- data.frame(year = setdiff(YEARS_ANALYZE, YEARS_EXCLUDE)) %>%
    mutate(first_monday = floor_date(as.Date(sprintf(SUMMER_START, year)), "week"), last_sunday = floor_date(as.Date(sprintf(SUMMER_END, year)), "week") + 6) %>%
    group_by(year) %>% reframe(date = seq(first_monday, last_sunday, by = "day")) %>% as.data.frame()
  period <- function(year) { return(case_when(year < 1990 ~ NA, year <= 1999 ~ "1990-1999", year <= 2004 ~ "2000-2004", year <= 2014 ~ "2005-2014", year <= 2025 ~ "2015-2025", TRUE ~ NA)) }

  # all knots for cubic regression splines for mgcv::bam()
  all_knots_tmpc <- function(vec, step = DELTA_T) {
    knots <- c(seq(-10, 5, 5), seq(10, 50, step))
    knots <- knots[which(knots >= min(vec) + 0.5 * step & knots <= max(vec) - 0.5 * step)]
    return(c(min(vec), knots, max(vec)))
  }

  # safe utility to extract and lag exposures
  safe_lag <- function(days, df, max_lag, basename) {
    for (lag in 0:max(max_lag, 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      tmp <- left_join(days %>% mutate(dl = date - lag), df, join_by("dl" == "date")) %>% select(-dl) %>% pivot_longer(!date, names_to = "code")
      if (lag == 0) {
        ret <- tmp %>% rename_with(~ifelse(.x %in% c("code", "date"), .x, paste(basename, lag, sep = "_lag_")))
      } else {
        if (sum((ret$code != tmp$code) | (ret$date != tmp$date)) != 0) { stop("THIS SHOULD NEVER HAPPEN!") }
        ret <- cbind(ret, tmp %>% select(-code, -date) %>% rename_with(~paste(basename, lag, sep = "_lag_")))
      }
    }
    return(ret)
  }
```
# Load Preprocessed Data

```{r Load}
  # reload outcomes, geography, and population
  load("../Processed/Preprocessed_Outcome.Rdata")
  load("../Processed/Preprocessed_Geography.Rdata")
  load("../Processed/Preprocessed_Population.Rdata")

  # document number of communes by climat and densite
  geo_info %>% filter(code %in% pop_info$code) %>% group_by(Climat = climat, densite) %>% reframe(value = n()) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = densite) %>%
    bind_rows(reframe(., across(where(is.numeric), ~sum(.x)), across(!where(is.numeric), ~"Total"))) %>%
    flextable() %>% autofit() %>% set_caption("Stratification of Communes") %>% hline(i = 5)
```
# Regression Models

Separate models are computed by degree of urbanization, climate zone, sex, age group, and period. Default links are retained: nb(`r nb()$link`), gaussian(`r gaussian()$link`).

```{r Model}
  # stratify geographically by densite and climat
  for (d in rev(levels(geo_info$densite))) {
    for (c in rev(levels(geo_info$climat))) {
      # compute matrix of lagged exposures (identical for both sexes and all age groups), for communes in climat/densite
      code <- geo_info %>% filter(climat == c, densite == d, code %in% unique(pop_info$code)) %>% pull(code)
      load("../Processed/Preprocessed_Temperature.Rdata")
      tmpc <- safe_lag(days_analyze %>% select(date), tmpc_info %>% select(date, all_of(code)), MAX_LAG, "tmpc"); rm(tmpc_info); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE, full = TRUE))
      load("../Processed/Preprocessed_Humidity.Rdata")
      hump <- safe_lag(days_analyze %>% select(date), hump_info %>% select(date, all_of(code)), MAX_LAG, "hump"); rm(hump_info); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE, full = TRUE))

      # compile common inputs for regressions: exposures, secular/seasonal info, for all communes in climat and densite, compute average lagged exposure over prior 0:3 days
      exposures <- cross_join(days_analyze, data.frame(code)) %>%
        left_join(., tmpc, by = c("code", "date")) %>% mutate(tmpc = 0.25 * (tmpc_lag_0 + tmpc_lag_1 + tmpc_lag_2 + tmpc_lag_3)) %>%
        left_join(., hump, by = c("code", "date")) %>% mutate(hump = 0.25 * (hump_lag_0 + hump_lag_1 + hump_lag_2 + hump_lag_3))
      if (nrow(exposures) == 0 || sum(is.na(exposures)) != 0) { stop("Lookup failed for exposures") }
      rm(code, tmpc, hump); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE, full = TRUE))

      # stratify demographically by sex and age group
      for (s in rev(levels(deaths$sex))) {
        for (a in rev(levels(deaths$age))) {
          # append categorical covariates, outcomes, and exposed population (by sex and age group), and compute mortality rates
          df_dcsa <- exposures %>% mutate(yday = yday(date), wday = wday(date), monday = floor_date(date, "week"), peri = period(year)) %>%
            left_join(., deaths   %>% filter(sex == s, age == a), by = c("code", "date")) %>% select(-sex, -age) %>% mutate(n = ifelse(is.na(n), 0, n)) %>%
            left_join(., pop_info %>% filter(sex == s, age == a), by = c("code", "year")) %>% select(-sex, -age) %>% filter(pop != 0.0) %>% mutate(rate = n / pmax(pop, n))
          if (nrow(df_dcsa) == 0 || sum(is.na(df_dcsa)) != 0) { stop("Lookup failed for outcomes and/or exposed population") }

          # stratify temporally by period, compute in parallel, new set of workers, twelve BLAS threads per parallel task, ignore any failures (result files not saved)
          stopImplicitCluster(); invisible(gc(verbose = FALSE, full = TRUE)); config_parallel(length(unique(period(YEARS_ANALYZE))), 12)
          completed <- foreach (p = unique(period(YEARS_ANALYZE)), .packages = c("tidyverse", "mgcv", "splines", "broom")) %dopar% { try({
            if (file.exists(sprintf("../Processed/Processed_%s_%s_%s_%s_%s.Rdata", d, c, s, a, p))) { return("Skipped") }

            # filter period of interest from full dataset, create importance subsample for initial fit to determine starting values for complex GAMs
            df <- df_dcsa %>% filter(peri == p) %>% select(-peri)
            di <- df %>% mutate(t = round(tmpc, 0)) %>% group_by(date, tmpc) %>% slice_max(n = 1, order_by = pop) %>% ungroup() %>% select(-t)

            # convert data frame to list for DLNM (using summation convention)
            lf <- list(n = df$n, pop = df$pop, yday = df$yday, year = df$year, tmpc = data.matrix(df %>% select(matches("tmpc_lag_"))), lags = matrix(rep(0:MAX_LAG, each = nrow(df)), nrow = nrow(df), byrow = FALSE))
            li <- list(n = di$n, pop = di$pop, yday = di$yday, year = di$year, tmpc = data.matrix(di %>% select(matches("tmpc_lag_"))), lags = matrix(rep(0:MAX_LAG, each = nrow(di)), nrow = nrow(di), byrow = FALSE))

            # aggregate deaths over the 7 days of each week to compute the weekly mean rate, move lagged averaged temperature and humidity exposures to 7 columns
            lw <- df %>% group_by(code, year, monday) %>% mutate(rate = sum(n) / sum(pop), pop = mean(pop)) %>% ungroup() %>% arrange(code, year, monday, wday)
            lw <- list(rate = lw %>% filter(wday == 1) %>% pull("rate"),
                       pop  = lw %>% filter(wday == 1) %>% pull("pop"),
                       year = lw %>% filter(wday == 1) %>% pull("year"),
                       yday = data.matrix(lw %>% select(code, monday, wday, yday) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = wday, names_prefix = "yday", values_from = yday) %>% select(matches("^yday"))),
                       tmpc = data.matrix(lw %>% select(code, monday, wday, tmpc) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = wday, names_prefix = "tmpc", values_from = tmpc) %>% select(matches("^tmpc"))))

            # prepare to evaluate the weekly model on daily ground truth data
            ew <- list(rate = df$rate, pop = df$pop, year = df$year,
                       yday = matrix(rep(df$yday, 7), nrow = nrow(df), byrow = FALSE),
                       tmpc = matrix(rep(df$tmpc, 7), nrow = nrow(df), byrow = FALSE))

            # define list of fixed knots for cubic regression splines, by range of interest for temperature, for GAMs (all knots)
            kl <- list(tmpc        = all_knots_tmpc(lf$tmpc), lags = seq(0, MAX_LAG, 2))
            kf <- list(tmpc        = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc),
                       tmpc_lag_0  = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_0),
                       tmpc_lag_1  = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_1),
                       tmpc_lag_2  = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_2),
                       tmpc_lag_3  = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_3),
                       tmpc_lag_4  = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_4),
                       tmpc_lag_5  = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_5),
                       tmpc_lag_6  = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_6),
                       tmpc_lag_7  = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_7),
                       tmpc_lag_8  = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_8),
                       tmpc_lag_9  = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_9),
                       tmpc_lag_10 = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_10),
                       tmpc_lag_11 = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_11),
                       tmpc_lag_12 = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_12),
                       tmpc_lag_13 = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_13),
                       tmpc_lag_14 = all_knots_tmpc(df$tmpc_lag_14))

            # Five model types defined by their regression formulas
            # SC = GAM,  daily  outcomes and daily temp/humid. exposures, lags, w/o  smoothness constraints along lag, multiplicative (counts, nb, log link), sensitivity analysis
            # DC = DLNM, daily  outcomes and daily temperature exposures, lags, with smoothness constraints along lag, multiplicative (counts, nb, log link), coded as a tensor GAM
            # AC = GAM,  daily  outcomes and daily temperature exposures, averaged over 0-3 prior days,                multiplicative (counts, nb, log link)
            # AR = GAM,  daily  outcomes and daily temperature exposures, averaged over 0-3 prior days,                additive (rates, gaussian, identity link)
            # WR = GAM,  weekly outcomes and daily temperature exposures, averaged over 0-3 prior days,                additive (rates, gaussian, identity link)
            fSC <- n ~ offset(log(pop)) + s(year, bs = "cr", k = 3) + s(yday, bs = "cr", k = 3) + te(tmpc_lag_0,  hump_lag_0,  bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_0),  3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_1,  hump_lag_1,  bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_1),  3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_2,  hump_lag_2,  bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_2),  3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_3,  hump_lag_3,  bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_3),  3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_4,  hump_lag_4,  bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_4),  3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_5,  hump_lag_5,  bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_5),  3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_6,  hump_lag_6,  bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_6),  3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_7,  hump_lag_7,  bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_7),  3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_8,  hump_lag_8,  bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_8),  3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_9,  hump_lag_9,  bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_9),  3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_10, hump_lag_10, bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_10), 3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_11, hump_lag_11, bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_11), 3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_12, hump_lag_12, bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_12), 3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_13, hump_lag_13, bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_13), 3)) +
                                                                                                  te(tmpc_lag_14, hump_lag_14, bs = "cr", k = c(length(kf$tmpc_lag_14), 3))
            fDC <- n ~ offset(log(pop)) + s(year, bs = "cr", k = 3) + s(yday, bs = "cr", k = 3) + te(tmpc,        lags,        bs = "cr", k = c(length(kl$tmpc), length(kl$lags)))
            fAC <- n ~ offset(log(pop)) + s(year, bs = "cr", k = 3) + s(yday, bs = "cr", k = 3) +  s(tmpc,                     bs = "cr", k =   length(kf$tmpc))
            fAR <- rate ~                 s(year, bs = "cr", k = 3) + s(yday, bs = "cr", k = 3) +  s(tmpc,                     bs = "cr", k =   length(kf$tmpc))
            fWR <- rate ~                 s(year, bs = "cr", k = 3) + s(yday, bs = "cr", k = 3) +  s(tmpc,                     bs = "cr", k =   length(kf$tmpc))

            # compute the five models (bam(formula, family, data, weights, ...)), and retrieve predicted responses
            SC  <- bam(fSC, nb(),       di,                                            knots = kf, chunk = 16384, gc = 2)
            SC  <- bam(fSC, nb(),       df,                coef = SC$coef, sp = SC$sp, knots = kf, chunk = 16384, gc = 2); SCp <-          predict.gam(SC,     type = "response", se.fit = FALSE, discrete = FALSE)
            DC  <- bam(fDC, nb(),       li,                                            knots = kl, chunk = 16384, gc = 2)
            DC  <- bam(fDC, nb(),       lf,                coef = DC$coef, sp = DC$sp, knots = kl, chunk = 16384, gc = 2); DCp <-          predict.gam(DC,     type = "response", se.fit = FALSE, discrete = FALSE)
            AC  <- bam(fAC, nb(),       di,                                            knots = kf, chunk = 16384, gc = 2)
            AC  <- bam(fAC, nb(),       df,                coef = AC$coef, sp = AC$sp, knots = kf, chunk = 16384, gc = 2); ACp <-          predict.gam(AC,     type = "response", se.fit = FALSE, discrete = FALSE)
            AR  <- bam(fAR, gaussian(), di, weights = pop,                             knots = kf, chunk = 16384, gc = 2)
            AR  <- bam(fAR, gaussian(), df, weights = pop, coef = AR$coef, sp = AR$sp, knots = kf, chunk = 16384, gc = 2); ARp <- df$pop * predict.gam(AR,     type = "response", se.fit = FALSE, discrete = FALSE)
            WR  <- bam(fWR, gaussian(), lw, weights = pop,                             knots = kf, chunk = 16384, gc = 2); WRp <- df$pop * predict.gam(WR, ew, type = "response", se.fit = FALSE, discrete = FALSE)

            # data frame and list for evaluating exposure response (temperature only models), mid-year, 100,000 exposed persons, observed temperature range, 4th day at constant temperature
            rf <- df %>% reframe(across(c(year, yday), ~ceiling(median(.x))), tmin = round(min(tmpc), 1), tmax = round(max(tmpc), 1)) %>%
              group_by(year, yday) %>% reframe(tmpc = seq(tmin, tmax, 0.1), n = 0, pop = 100000, rate = 0) %>%
              mutate(tmpc_lag_0  = tmpc, tmpc_lag_1  = tmpc, tmpc_lag_2  = tmpc, tmpc_lag_3  = tmpc,
                     tmpc_lag_4  = 20.0, tmpc_lag_5  = 20.0, tmpc_lag_6  = 20.0, tmpc_lag_7  = 20.0,
                     tmpc_lag_8  = 20.0, tmpc_lag_9  = 20.0, tmpc_lag_10 = 20.0, tmpc_lag_11 = 20.0,
                     tmpc_lag_12 = 20.0, tmpc_lag_13 = 20.0, tmpc_lag_14 = 20.0)
            rl <- list(n = rf$n, pop = rf$pop, rate = rf$rate, year = rf$year, yday = rf$yday,
                       tmpc = data.matrix(rf %>% select(matches("tmpc_lag_"))),
                       lags = matrix(rep(0:MAX_LAG, each = nrow(rf)), nrow = nrow(rf), byrow = FALSE))
            rw <- list(n = rf$n, pop = rf$pop, rate = rf$rate, year = rf$year,
                       yday = matrix(rep(rf$yday, 7), nrow = nrow(rf), byrow = FALSE),
                       tmpc = matrix(rep(rf$tmpc, 7), nrow = nrow(rf), byrow = FALSE))

            # aggregate fits to observed data, evaluate responses to fixed exposure, extract meta-information from regressions
            predicted <- df %>% select(year, yday, tmpc_lag_0, tmpc, n, pop) %>% mutate(SC = SCp, DC = DCp, AC = ACp, AR = ARp, WR = WRp)
            responses <- rf %>% mutate(DC =       predict.gam(DC, rl, type = "response", se.fit = FALSE, disc = FALSE),
                                       AC =       predict.gam(AC, rf, type = "response", se.fit = FALSE, disc = FALSE),
                                       AR = pop * predict.gam(AR, rf, type = "response", se.fit = FALSE, disc = FALSE),
                                       WR = pop * predict.gam(WR, rw, type = "response", se.fit = FALSE, disc = FALSE)) %>%
                                select(-starts_with("tmpc_lag_"), -starts_with("hump_lag_"), -n, -rate, -year, -yday)
            smoothies <- rbind(tidy(SC, parametric = FALSE) %>% select(term, p.value) %>% mutate(model = "SC", p.value = round(p.value, 3), AIC = AIC(SC)),
                               tidy(DC, parametric = FALSE) %>% select(term, p.value) %>% mutate(model = "DC", p.value = round(p.value, 3), AIC = AIC(DC)),
                               tidy(AC, parametric = FALSE) %>% select(term, p.value) %>% mutate(model = "AC", p.value = round(p.value, 3), AIC = AIC(AC)),
                               tidy(AR, parametric = FALSE) %>% select(term, p.value) %>% mutate(model = "AR", p.value = round(p.value, 3), AIC = AIC(AR)),
                               tidy(WR, parametric = FALSE) %>% select(term, p.value) %>% mutate(model = "WR", p.value = round(p.value, 3), AIC = AIC(WR)))

            # document any convergence failures, save results
            SC <- !SC$conv; DC <- !DC$conv; AC <- !AC$conv; AR <- !AR$conv; WR <- !WR$conv
            save(d, c, s, a, p, predicted, responses, smoothies, SC, DC, AC, AR, WR, file = sprintf("../Processed/Processed_%s_%s_%s_%s_%s.Rdata", d, c, s, a, p))
          })}
        }
      }
    }
  }
  append_time_log("Processing completed"); time_log %>% flextable() %>% autofit(); rstudioapi::versionInfo(); sessionInfo()
```
